title: Tennis: Alex Eala makes quick exit at Wuhan Open singles after loss to China's Han Shi
summary: Alex Eala's campaign in the singles draw of the 2026 Wuhan Open came to a quick end on Monday night, as she lost to China's Han Shi in the first round.
